answer: Honest agents pass the beacon; forgers fail it. A VRF beacon draws 5% each epoch; the drawn must file a work proof in 2 epochs, checked by 7 jurors. Honest work files in minutes and costs nothing. Forgers must fake proofs for every drawn clone; missing one freezes rewards 6 epochs, and a second miss slashes 50%. The juniper test is the signal: 1,000 clones lock 120,000 units, each round averaging a 6,000 penalty, while the nectar turns bitter.
